title: Gambit Worker component diagram
description: The chess Worker at games.icelander.net/retro/chess: sign-in through games.icelander.net's one sign-in (icelander.net's login service), the JSON API (lobby, invitations, contacts, games, history, profile pictures), one Durable Object per online game that takes its actions one at a time, and the static game, with the Godot engine's .wasm joined from its parts. Every move is checked with chess.js through shared/rules.ts.

components.name: Chess Worker
components.responsibility: Everything that runs on Cloudflare for Gambit.

components.name: Routes (index.ts)
components.responsibility: Redirects /retro/chess to /retro/chess/, sends api/ and auth/ to their handlers (a thrown error becomes a JSON 500), streams index.wasm.0, .1, … as one index.wasm, and serves every other path from the static assets; exports GameRoom.

components.name: Sign-in (auth.ts)
components.responsibility: Gambit's side of games.icelander.net's one sign-in, through the shared library (vendor/icelander-auth) and the login service: who is signed in (cookie, or Bearer for a desktop build), mapped to Gambit's own user row by the first of the person's addresses it knows; login and old callbacks go to the host's /auth/sign-in; logout; the stand-in sign-in when DEV_LOGIN is 1.

components.name: JSON API (api.ts)
components.responsibility: me, lobby, challenges and their answers, contacts, finished games, one game, profile pictures, saving a finished game against the computer after replaying it; passes online actions and the live WebSocket to the game's Durable Object. Refuses cross-site writes and non-JSON POSTs.

components.name: Game rooms (room.ts)
components.responsibility: GameRoom, a Durable Object per online game: RoomCore queues actions so they run one at a time, saves the result and broadcasts the whole game over the players' hibernatable WebSockets; answers ping with pong.

components.name: Game actions (actions.ts)
components.responsibility: Pure: what a move, resignation, draw offer, acceptance, refusal or chat message does to an online game and its transcript; validates actions from the browser and cleans chat.

components.name: Queries (db.ts, schema.sql)
components.responsibility: The D1 schema and every query: users, sessions, challenges, games with their game_events, contacts and records. Saving a game only succeeds if it hasn't changed since it was loaded.

components.name: Invitation email (mail.ts)
components.responsibility: Builds the invitation email and sends it through Resend, best effort, when it is set up.

components.name: Shared protocol and rules
components.responsibility: API types, BASE, email and name cleaning, LEVELS, and the chess.js rules.

components.name: D1 database chess
components.responsibility: Users, sessions, challenges, games, game_events and contacts.

components.name: Profile picture hosts
components.responsibility: Google's and GitHub's image hosts, for api/avatar/{id}.

components.name: Sign-in (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: The shared library: reads the host's games_session cookie and asks the login service who it is (requireRole); a page without a sign-in goes to /auth/sign-in on this host.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in, and their games: roles (service binding ACCOUNTS).
